architecture_notes.layer1: XGBClassifier (no Pipeline) with NaN handled natively
architecture_notes.layer2: Dual-purpose: escalation (clinical danger → referral) AND de-escalation (ML-flagged + no danger → monitoring)
architecture_notes.threshold_selection: Recall-prioritized on OOF probabilities only. Value: 0.5048. Addresses: FN (missed LBW) costs more than FP (extra referral).
architecture_notes.leakage_prevention: GroupShuffleSplit + StratifiedGroupKFold; 89 mothers with multiple records; zero overlap verified by assertion.

limitations: AUC ceiling ~0.58-0.65 for NDHS sociodemographic features (no hemoglobin/BMI)
OOF referral rate ~39-43% — mitigated by dual-purpose Layer 2 de-escalation
Layer 2 RQ3 evidence is simulation-based (no real BP/MUAC in NDHS)
Small training set: ~1,267 rows, ~155 LBW cases
